query: US spot Bitcoin ETF net flows late June 2026 and early July 2026, weekly trend from Farside Investors and SoSoValue. Are net outflows continuing into the week of June 29-July 3 2026? What is the Bitcoin price trend in late June 2026?
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings:

## Summary

**Yes, net outflows definitively continued into the week of June 29–July 3, 2026.** US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded **~$526.64M in net outflows** that week — the **eighth consecutive week** of outflows (confirmed by both SoSoValue and Farside Investors).

**Weekly trend:**
- **June 29:** –$231M (IBIT –$300.4M, partly offset by ARKB +$50M, GBTC +$35.1M)
- **June 29–July 2:** ~$527M cumulative outflows; three straight heavy-selling days
- **July 3:** +$221.7M inflow (largest in two months), ending a 10-day outflow streak and partially stemming the week's bleed

**Broader context:** June 2026 was the **worst month on record** (~$4.06B outflows, beating Feb 2025's $3.56B). The eight-week streak totaled **>$8.2B**, and H1 2026 was the first negative half-year since launch (~$5.4B YTD redemptions).

**Bitcoin price (late June):** Clear downtrend — BTC fell from ~$66,289 (Jun 15) to a **cycle low of $58,559 on June 30** (~–11%), coinciding with peak redemptions, then recovered to $62,544 by July 3 as flows reversed. Current price (Jul 27): ~$64,805.

Structured findings with all data points and sources have been recorded.
key_facts: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded ~$526.64M net outflows during the week of June 29–July 3, 2026 — the eighth consecutive week of net outflows (SoSoValue & Farside).
Outflows definitively continued into that week; ~$527M drained June 29–July 2 before a July 3 reversal.
June 29, 2026 (Farside): total net flow –$231M, with IBIT –$300.4M partially offset by ARKB +$50M and GBTC +$35.1M.
July 3, 2026: +$221.7M inflow — largest single-day intake in two months — ended a 10-day outflow streak; FBTC led (~$166M) while IBIT still had –$40.43M.
June 2026 was the worst month on record for US spot BTC ETFs: ~$4.06B net outflows, exceeding the prior low of $3.56B (Feb 2025).
The eight-week outflow streak (early May–July 3, 2026) totaled over $8.2 billion.
H1 2026 was the first negative half-year since launch (Jan 2024), with ~$5.4B in YTD net redemptions.
End-June 2026 total AUM across US spot Bitcoin ETFs was ~$72.82 billion.
Bitcoin fell from ~$66,289 (Jun 15) to a cycle low of $58,559 on June 30, 2026 (~–11% in the back half of June), coinciding with peak ETF redemptions.
BTC recovered to $62,544 by July 3 as flows reversed; as of July 27, 2026 it trades ~$64,805 (–48.6% below 52-week high of $126,198).
After the window, flows turned positive: ~$510M inflows July 2–7 and a 7-session run of ~$981.2M July 14–22, the largest inflow run of 2026.
